svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Prioritize arrival time over price on work rideshare trips because my employer covers the
cost. → Decide whether to take a ride by weighing the trip's duration and price.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Wait before booking when the price is too high. → Decide whether to take a ride by weighin
g the trip's duration and price.
